What it can put on your tax return

HMRC lists 0 of 16 other income and tax-return items as ready now, 16 in development. "In development" means the provider has told HMRC it will build it in time for the 2026 to 2027 tax return.

Getting started

  1. Check you need MTD and when: our plain-English guide.
  2. Sign up for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax on GOV.UK, if you haven't already.
  3. Choose your software, then authorise it with HMRC.
